qe: Which district of Bihar is popularly called the 'Granary of Bihar' because of its large production of rice and wheat?
qh: धान तथा गेहूं के अधिक उत्पादन के कारण बिहार के किस जिले को 'बिहार का अन्न भंडार' (Granary of Bihar) कहा जाता है?
e: Rohtas jile ko 'Bihar ka anna-bhandar' (Granary of Bihar) kaha jaata hai kyunki yahan dhan (rice) tatha gehun (wheat) ka utpadan tatha prati hectare paidawar dono rajya me sabse aage rehte hain. Iska mukhya karan Sone nadi par bana command-kshetra (Indrapuri Barrage tatha Dehri ke paas Sone Canal) hai, jisse saal bhar sinchai ke liye paani milta hai; isi ke saath yahan ki mitti tatha mausam bhi anaaj ke liye anukool hai. Sone command kshetra me Dehri, Sasaram tatha Bikramganj ke aas-paas bade khet hain tatha yahi kshetra chana, masoor tatha sarson me bhi aage hai. Isi liye Rohtas ko dhan-gehun ka pramukh jila kaha jaata hai, jabki Bhagalpur silk tatha Zardalu aam ke liye, Muzaffarpur Shahi Litchi ke liye tatha Purnea jute-banana-makka ke liye prasiddh hai. Isliye is prashn ka sahi uttar Rohtas hai. Exam point: 'Granary of Bihar' = Rohtas; Sone nadi tatha Sone Canal command kshetra ke karan dhan-gehun utpadan me pratham; Dehri-on-Sone tatha Indrapuri Barrage isi jile/kshetra se juda hai.

qe: Which district of Bihar has tea gardens, found mainly near Thakurganj, and records the highest rainfall in the state?
qh: बिहार का कौन-सा जिला चाय के बागानों के लिए जाना जाता है, जो मुख्यतः ठाकुरगंज के पास हैं तथा राज्य में सर्वाधिक वर्षा दर्ज करता है?
e: Kishanganj Bihar ka purabi kona hai jahan Himalaya ki tarai-patti tatha Darjeeling ki pahadiyon ka asar padta hai; isi karan yahan saalana varshik barsaat 1,800 millimetre se adhik hoti hai, jo Bihar me sabse zyada hai. Yahi nami wala mausam chai (tea) ke paudhon ke liye anukool hota hai, isliye Thakurganj tatha aas-paas ke kshetra me chai ke chhote bagan tatha chai processing ki koshishein dikhti hain; Bihar me chai utpadan mukhya roop se isi jile me hota hai. Yahan jute, dhan, makka, pineapple tatha aalu ki kheti bhi achhi hoti hai tatha 'Bihar ki chai' ko rajya sarkar protsahit karti hai. Araria tatha Katihar Seemanchal ke anya jile hain, lekin unki barsaat tatha chai-bagan dono Kishanganj se kam hain; West Champaran ko ganne tatha Valmiki kshetra ke liye jaana jaata hai. Isliye sahi uttar Kishanganj hai. Exam point: Kishanganj = Bihar ka sabse zyada varshik barsaat wala jila (1,800 mm se adhik) tatha chai baganon ka mukhya kshetra (Thakurganj); Bihar ka ekmatra Muslim-bahul jila bhi Kishanganj hai.

qe: Which is the least populous district of Bihar as per Census 2011, and it was carved out of Munger district in 1994?
qh: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार बिहार का सबसे कम जनसंख्या वाला जिला कौन-सा है, जो 1994 में मुंगेर जिले से अलग बनाया गया था?
e: Census 2011 me Bihar ka sabse kam jansankhya wala jila Sheikhpura hai; iski jansankhya lagbhag 6.36 lakh tatha kshetrafal bhi chhota hai, isliye yah rajy ke chhote jilon me ginta hai. Sheikhpura 1994 me Munger jile se alag kar ek naya jila banaya gaya tatha ise Magadh pramandal me rakha gaya; Munger jile ka ek bada kshetra pehle isi ke andar aata tha, jahan ki aarth-vyavastha kshetriya krishi tatha kuch chhoti audyogik ikaiyon par nirbhar hai. Sheohar ka kshetrafal sabse chhota hai tatha wahan ghanatv sabse adhik hai, Arwal 2001 me bane jile ke roop me jaana jaata hai tatha Kaimur ki ghanatv sabse kam hai - isliye inhe mila dena aam galti hoti hai. Jansankhya tatha kshetrafal ke aankdon ko alag-alag yaad rakhna zaroori hai. Exam point: Census 2011 me sabse kam jansankhya wala jila = Sheikhpura (1994 me Munger se alag bana); sabse chhota kshetrafal tatha sabse zyada ghanatv wala jila = Sheohar, sabse kam ghanatv = Kaimur.

qe: Pitaunjhia village, renamed 'Karpuri Gram', the birthplace of Karpoori Thakur, is in which district?
qh: 'कर्पूरी ग्राम' नाम से पुनर्नामित पितौंझिया गाँव, जो कर्पूरी ठाकुर की जन्मस्थली है, किस जिले में है?
e: Karpoori Thakur ka janm Samastipur jile ke Pitaunjhia gaon me hua tha, jise unke samman me aaj 'Karpuri Gram' ke naam se jaana jaata hai. Karpoori Thakur, jinko 'Jan Nayak' kaha jaata hai, Bihar ke Mukhyamantri rahe tatha 1978 me Mungeri Lal Aayog ki sifarishon par shrenibaddh (tiered) aarakshan lagu kiya; unhe 2024 me marnoparat Bharat Ratna se sammanit kiya gaya. Samastipur jila Bihar me shehrikaran ke maamle me sabse peeche rehne wale jilon me ginta hai (Census 2011 me lagbhag 3.47 pratishat), kyunki yahan jansankhya mukhya roop se gaon tatha kheti par nirbhar hai; isi ke saath yahan dudh utpadan tatha Karpuri Gram jaise smriti-sthal ka mahatva bhi hai. Darbhanga, Begusarai tatha Khagaria anya padosi jile hain, lekin Karpoori Thakur ka janm-sthal Samastipur me hai, isliye sahi uttar Samastipur hai. Exam point: 'Karpuri Gram' (purana Pitaunjhia) = Samastipur jila; Karpoori Thakur 'Jan Nayak', 1978 shrenibaddh aarakshan (Mungeri Lal Aayog) tatha 2024 Bharat Ratna; Samastipur shehrikaran me sabse kam (lagbhag 3.47%).

qe: In Census 2011, which district of Bihar had the lowest decadal population growth rate in 2001-2011?
qh: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार 2001-2011 में बिहार के किस जिले में दशकीय जनसंख्या वृद्धि दर सबसे कम थी?
e: 2001 se 2011 ke beech Bihar ki ausat dasahkiya jansankhya vriddhi lagbhag 25.42 pratishat thi, lekin har jile me yah ek jaisi nahi rahi. Rajya me sarvadhik vriddhi Madhepura jile me dekhi gayi (lagbhag 31.1 pratishat), jabki sabse kam vriddhi Arwal jile me rahi (lagbhag 18.9 pratishat); isi karan in dono ko ek saath yaad rakhna pariksha ke liye faaydemand hai. Arwal jile ka kshetrafal chhota hai tatha yah dakshin Bihar ke maidan me aata hai, jahan logon ka ek hissa kaam ke liye bahar jaata hai, jisse gine gaye nivasiyon ki sankhya par asar padta hai. Sheohar tatha Araria ki vriddhi dar isi beech ki rehti hai, isliye woh vikalp sahi nahi. Isi tarah jansankhya-ghatv, linganupat tatha saaksharta ke sabse adhik-kam wale jile alag hote hain tatha pariksha me inki jodi poochhi jaati hai. Exam point: 2001-2011 ki sabse kam vriddhi = Arwal (lagbhag 18.9%); sabse zyada vriddhi = Madhepura (lagbhag 31.1%); Bihar ki ausat vriddhi 25.42% (bharat 17.64%).

qe: Which district of Bihar has the leading position in the productivity of sesame (til), and is also a plateau-margin district?
qh: तिल (sesame) की प्रति हेक्टेयर उत्पादकता में अग्रणी तथा पठारी किनारे वाला जिला कौन-सा है?
e: Banka jila Bihar ke dakshin-purab me Jharkhand seema se laga hua hai tatha pahari-patti wala kshetra hai; yahan til (sesame) ki prati hectare utpadakta rajya me sabse aage maani jaati hai. Til ek tilhan (oilseed) fasal hai jise kam paani me bhi ugaya ja sakta hai tatha iske beej se tel nikalta hai; Gaya ka prasiddh 'tilkut' bhi til se hi banta hai, isliye dakshin Bihar ke pathari jile til-tilkut ke liye jaane jaate hain. Banka ke sath-saath Gaya tatha Nawada jile til tatha linseed (tisi) ke liye jaane jaate hain, kyunki yahan ki halki lal-pili mitti tatha kam barsaat aise telahan fasalon ke liye theek rehti hai. Patna (masoor-Mokama), Darbhanga (makhana) tatha Saran (Sonepur mela tatha ganna) anya vishayon ke liye prasiddh hain, isliye sahi uttar Banka hai. Exam point: til ki sarvasadhik prati hectare utpadakta wala jila = Banka; Gaya 'tilkut' ke liye prasiddh; dakshin Bihar ke Kaimur-Gaya-Nawada-Banka kshetra me til tatha tisi (linseed) ki kheti aam hai.

qe: Rajauli Wildlife Sanctuary, located in a hilly forest landscape near the Jharkhand border, is in which district?
qh: झारखंड सीमा के निकट पहाड़ी-वन क्षेत्र में स्थित राजौली वन्यजीव अभयारण्य किस जिले में है?
e: Rajauli Wildlife Sanctuary Nawada jile me sthit hai tatha yah Koderma plateau tatha Jharkhand seema ki pahadiyon se lage sookhe patjhad (dry deciduous) jungle ka kshetra hai; iska area lagbhag 27 square kilometre hai. Rajya ke sabse naye protected-area records me Rajauli ko van jeevon ke liye mahatvapurn sthal maana gaya hai, jahan leopard, sloth bear, chital tatha wild boar jaise jeev milte hain. Isi jile me mica ka prasiddh kshetra tatha Kakolat jalprapat bhi hai, isliye Nawada ko ek hi baar me khanij (mica), jalprapat (Kakolat) tatha van-jeev (Rajauli) - teeno se jodkar yaad rakhna upyogi hai. Jamui jile me Nagi-Nakti pakshi abhayaranya tatha Sono ka svarn kshetra hai, Banka me til utpadakta tatha Gaya me Bodh Gaya tatha Gautam Buddha Wildlife Sanctuary hai - isliye Rajouli ke liye Nawada hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Rajauli Wildlife Sanctuary = Nawada jila (lagbhag 27 square kilometre, Jharkhand seema ke pahadi kshetra me); Nawada hi mica tatha Kakolat jalprapat se bhi juda hai.

qe: Magahi Paan, a GI-tagged betel leaf of Bihar, belongs mainly to which division of the state?
qh: बिहार का जीआई टैग प्राप्त मगही पान मुख्यतः राज्य के किस प्रमंडल से संबंधित है?
e: Magahi Paan Bihar ke Magadh pramandal ki prasiddh paan (betel leaf) hai; ise 2018 me GI (Geographical Indication) tag mila, jisme Nawada, Gaya, Aurangabad tatha Nalanda (Islampur-Hilsa) ke kshetra shaamil hain. Paan ki bel ko nami tatha chhaya wala mahaul chahiye hota hai, isliye iski kheti ke liye alag 'bareja' banaye jaate hain. Magadh kshetra ki mitti tatha mausam is paan ko patla, mulayam tatha halki meethas wala banate hain, isliye iski maang desh bhar me rehti hai. Isi kshetra me Patna tatha Gaya ke aas-paas anya fasalein bhi hoti hain, lekin Magahi paan ka mukhya kshetra Nawada-Gaya-Aurangabad hi maana jaata hai; Tirhut, Kosi tatha Purnea pramandal litchi, makhana, makka tatha jute jaise utpadon ke liye jaane jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Magadh pramandal hai. Exam point: Magahi Paan (GI 2018) = Magadh pramandal, mukhya jile Nawada-Gaya-Aurangabad-Nalanda; paan 'bareja' me ugaya jaata hai jahan nami tatha chhaya rahti hai.

qe: Motihari, where Mahatma Gandhi reached during the Champaran Satyagraha and where a Gandhi memorial stands, is the headquarters of which district?
qh: चंपारण सत्याग्रह के दौरान महात्मा गांधी जहाँ पहुँचे तथा जहाँ गांधी स्मारक स्थित है, वह मोतिहारी किस जिले का मुख्यालय है?
e: Motihari aaj Purbi Champaran (East Champaran) jile ka mukhyalaya hai; April 1917 me Mahatma Gandhi Champaran Satyagraha ke dauran yahin pahunche the, jab unhone neel (indigo) kisanon ke tinkathia atyachar ki jaanch shuru ki. Unke aane par angrej sarkar ne unhe giraftar karne ka aadesh diya, par Gandhi ji ne aadesh nahi maana tatha janata ne bade paimana par unka samarthan kiya; isi pratirodh ke baad sarkar ko ek jaanch aayog banani padi tatha tinkathia vyavastha khatm hui. Motihari me aaj 'Gandhi Sangrahalaya' tatha smriti-sthal sthit hai, jahan unse judi vastuein tatha chitran sanrakshit hain; isi kshetra me Kesariya stupa (sabse uncha mana jaane wala ancient stupa) bhi hai. Pashchim Champaran me Bettiah tatha Valmikinagar sthit hain, jabki Sheohar tatha Sitamarhi alag jile hain, isliye sahi uttar Purbi Champaran hai. Exam point: Motihari = Purbi Champaran (East Champaran) ka mukhyalaya, 1917 ke Champaran Satyagraha ka pramukh sthal (Gandhi Sangrahalaya); Pashchim Champaran me Bettiah tatha Valmiki Tiger Reserve sthit hai.

qe: What is the total geographical area of Bihar, and which state does it border on the west?
qh: बिहार का कुल भौगोलिक क्षेत्रफल कितना है तथा इसके पश्चिम में कौन-सा राज्य स्थित है?
e: Bihar ka kul bhoogolik kshetra lagbhag 94,163 square kilometre (yaani karib 94,000 varg kilometre) hai tatha kshetrafal ke hisaab se yah bharat ke madhyaam star ke rajyon me aata hai. Bihar ke charon dishaayein is tarah hain - uttar me Nepal, pashchim me Uttar Pradesh, purab me West Bengal tatha dakshin me Jharkhand. Iske alava Bihar ka samudra tak koi kinara nahi hai, isliye yah ek 'bhumibaddh' (landlocked/sthir bhumi se ghira) rajya hai. Bhutan tatha Bangladesh Bihar se seedha nahi milte; Nepal ke saath Bihar ki sabse lambi antarrashtriya seema hai. 78,438 square kilometre Tripura ka, 1,30,058 square kilometre Tamil Nadu ke aas-paas ka tatha 2,14,081 square kilometre Andhra Pradesh ka kshetra hai, isliye ye aankde Bihar ke nahi hain. Exam point: Bihar ka kshetra = 94,163 varg kilometre; seema - uttar me Nepal, pashchim me Uttar Pradesh, purab me West Bengal, dakshin me Jharkhand; Bihar ek landlocked rajya hai.

qe: Between which latitudes and longitudes does Bihar lie?
qh: बिहार किन अक्षांशों तथा देशांतरों के बीच स्थित है?
oe: About 25 degrees 7 minutes to 27 degrees 17 minutes North latitude, and 83 degrees 19 minutes to 88 degrees 17 minutes East longitude
About 21 degrees 4 minutes to 24 degrees 10 minutes North latitude, and 80 degrees 15 minutes to 84 degrees 15 minutes East longitude
About 28 degrees 15 minutes to 30 degrees 25 minutes North latitude, and 76 degrees 20 minutes to 80 degrees 30 minutes East longitude
About 23 degrees 45 minutes to 26 degrees 10 minutes North latitude, and 90 degrees 20 minutes to 93 degrees 20 minutes East longitude
oh: लगभग 25 डिग्री 7 मिनट से 27 डिग्री 17 मिनट उत्तर अक्षांश तथा 83 डिग्री 19 मिनट से 88 डिग्री 17 मिनट पूर्वी देशांतर
लगभग 21 डिग्री 4 मिनट से 24 डिग्री 10 मिनट उत्तर अक्षांश तथा 80 डिग्री 15 मिनट से 84 डिग्री 15 मिनट पूर्वी देशांतर
लगभग 28 डिग्री 15 मिनट से 30 डिग्री 25 मिनट उत्तर अक्षांश तथा 76 डिग्री 20 मिनट से 80 डिग्री 30 मिनट पूर्वी देशांतर
लगभग 23 डिग्री 45 मिनट से 26 डिग्री 10 मिनट उत्तर अक्षांश तथा 90 डिग्री 20 मिनट से 93 डिग्री 20 मिनट पूर्वी देशांतर
e: Bihar ka vistar uttari golarddh me khand ke saath lagbhag 25 degree 7 minute se 27 degree 17 minute uttar akshansh tatha 83 degree 19 minute se 88 degree 17 minute poorvi deshantar ke beech hai. 'Akshansh' (latitude) zameen par uttar-dakshin ki sthiti batata hai tatha 'deshantar' (longitude) purab-pashchim ki sthiti batata hai. Bihar poori tarah uttari golarddh (Northern Hemisphere) me hai tatha 'Kark Rekha' (Tropic of Cancer, 23 degree 30 minute uttar) iske dakshin me hi reh jaati hai, isliye Kark Rekha Bihar se nahi guzarti. Bihar ka purab-pashchim vistar (tqreeban 5 degree deshantar) uttar-dakshin ke vistar se bada hai, isliye rajya charon taraf se jyada purab-pashchim me phaila dikhta hai. Diye gaye anya vikalp Odisha-Maharashtra kshetra, Punjab-Himachal kshetra tatha Assam-Meghalaya jaisi sthiti darshate hain, jo Bihar ke nahi hain. Exam point: Bihar lagbhag 25 degree 7 minute se 27 degree 17 minute uttar akshansh tatha 83 degree 19 minute se 88 degree 17 minute poorvi deshantar me; Kark Rekha Bihar se nahi guzarti.

qe: Which river divides the Bihar plain into its north and south parts, and on which bank does the state capital Patna lie?
qh: कौन-सी नदी बिहार के मैदान को उत्तर तथा दक्षिण भागों में बाँटती है तथा राजधानी पटना किस किनारे पर स्थित है?
e: Ganga nadi Bihar me pashchim se purab ki taraf behti hai tatha rajya ke maidan ko do hisson me baant deti hai - Ganga ke uttar ka hissa 'uttar Bihar maidan' (Tirhut, Saran, Darbhanga, Kosi tatha Purnea prabhag) aur Ganga ke dakshin ka hissa 'dakshin Bihar maidan' (Patna, Magadh, Munger tatha Shahabad kshetra). Rajdhani Patna Ganga ke dakshin kinare par sthit hai, isliye kaha jaata hai ki Patna south Bihar me hai. Ganga Bihar me Buxar ke nikat Chausa ke paas pashchim se pravesh karti hai tatha purab me Katihar jile ke aas-paas Bengal ki taraf badhti hai; Bihar me iski lambai lagbhag 445 kilometre maani jaati hai. Gandak, Kosi tatha Son sab Ganga ki sahayak nadiyan hain, lekin pura Bihar maidan ko uttar-dakshin me baantne ka kaam sirf Ganga karti hai. Isliye 'Ganga, dakshin kinara' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Bihar ko uttar-dakshin me baantne wali nadi = Ganga; Patna, Munger tatha Bhagalpur dakshin kinare par hain; uttar kinare ke pramukh shahar Hajipur, Muzaffarpur tatha Darbhanga hain.

qe: Which of the following is NOT a physiographic division of Bihar?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन बिहार का भौतिक-प्राकृतिक प्रदेश (physiographic division) नहीं है?
e: Bihar ko bhoo-aakritik (physiographic) roop se mukhya teen hisson me baanta jaata hai - pehla uttar Bihar maidan, jo Ganga ke uttar me Himalayan nadiyon (Gandak, Kosi, Bagmati, Burhi Gandak) se bani jalooh se bana hai; doosra dakshin Bihar maidan, jisme Ganga ke dakshin ke upland tatha puraane jalooh kshetra aate hain; tatha teesra Kaimur plateau ya Vindhyan kshetra, jo rajya ke dakshin-pashchim me Kaimur-Rohtas tatha Aurangabad-Gaya ke pahadi ilaake ko sametata hai. Thar marusthal (desert) Rajasthan tatha uske aas-paas ke kshetra me hai; Bihar me rethile marusthal nahi hain, balki Kosi kshetra me reth (ret) ke til (sand dunes) mile bhi hote hain to woh marusthal nahi kehlate. Bihar ka mausam monsoon-adharit hai tatha yahan saalana barsaat 1,000 millimetre se zyada hoti hai, isliye yahan Thar jaise sookhe marusthal ka sawaal hi nahi uthta. Isliye 'Thar desert' hi sahi jawab hai. Exam point: Bihar ke bhoo-aakritik pradesh - uttar Bihar maidan, dakshin Bihar maidan tatha Kaimur plateau (Vindhyan kshetra); Thar marusthal Bihar me nahi hai.

qe: The highest point of Bihar lies in West Champaran at which hill, close to the Nepal border?
qh: बिहार का सर्वोच्च बिंदु पश्चिम चंपारण में नेपाल सीमा के निकट किस पहाड़ी पर स्थित है?
e: Bihar ke uttar-pashchim kone me West Champaran jile ki Someshwar pahadi (Dun range ke aas-paas) Bihar ka sabse uncha sthal maani jaati hai, jaha samundar tal se unchai lagbhag 880 meter tak batayi jaati hai; Someshwar ka kila bhi isi pahadi par sthit hai. Yah kshetra Nepal ki seema ke bilkul paas hai tatha yahan Shivalik type ki foothills, tez dhalwan tatha ghaney jungle milte hain - isi karan yahi Bihar ka Valmiki Tiger Reserve ka landscape banata hai. Rajgir ki pahadiyan (Vaibhargiri, Ratnagiri, Vipulgiri) Nalanda me hain aur unki unchai isse bahut kam hai; Kharagpur pahadiyan Munger jile me hain tatha yah bhi Someshwar se kam unchi hain. Bihar ka dakshin kshetra aam taur par samundar tal se 80 se 150 meter ki unchai par hai, jabki Someshwar pahadi is vargikaran ka apvaad hai. Isliye 'Someshwar hill' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Bihar ka sarvocch sthal = Someshwar pahadi (West Champaran, karib 880 meter, Nepal seema ke nikat); Rajgir hills = Nalanda, Kharagpur hills = Munger.

qe: The low-lying saucer-shaped depressions in north Bihar which are used for rabi pulses and makhana are called:
qh: उत्तर बिहार के जिन तश्तरीनुमा नीचले गड्ढों (depressions) में रबी दलहन तथा मखाना उगाया जाता है, उन्हें क्या कहते हैं?
e: Uttar Bihar ke jheelon-jaisa nicha, tashtari (saucer) ke aakaran wala kshetra jahan barsaat ka paani bhar jaata hai tatha sookhe mausam me paani hat jaata hai, 'chaur' kahlata hai. Aise chaur me barsaat ke baad ki nami ka laabh uthakar rabi ki dalhan fasalein (masoor, chana, khesari) tatha makhana (fox nut) ugayi jaati hai; Kosi-Seemanchal kshetra ke chaur sabse prasiddh hain, jahan makhana vishwa-stariya paidawar deta hai. Isi tarah 'tal' shabd un nicha kshetraon ke liye istemal hota hai jahan paani der tak rukta hai - jaise Mokama tatha Barahiya tal, jahan masoor-chana ki bemisaal paidawar hoti hai. 'Bhabar' Shivalik ki talhati me bani motey kankad-patthar wali patti hai jahan nadiyan zameen me samaa jaati hain; 'doab' do nadiyon ke beech ki zameen ko kehte hain; 'khadar' naveen jalooh (nadi dwara laayi nayi mitti) wali zameen hai. Isliye prashn ke liye sahi shabd 'Chaur' hai. Exam point: Chaur = uttar Bihar ke nicha tashtari-shakal wale kshetra, makhana tatha rabi dalhan ke liye prasiddh; Tal = Mokama-Barahiya (rabi dalhan), Bhabar = Shivalik ke neeche pattharili patti.

qe: The narrow fertile valley tract lying below the Shivalik foothills in West Champaran, where streams deposit pebbles and the soil is acidic, is known as:
qh: पश्चिम चंपारण में शिवालिक की तलहटी के नीचे स्थित संकरा उपजाऊ घाटी-क्षेत्र, जहाँ नदियाँ कंकड़ जमा करती हैं तथा मिट्टी अम्लीय होती है, क्या कहलाता है?
e: West Champaran me Shivalik foothills ke theek neeche bani sankri ghati-jaisi patti ko 'Dun' kaha jaata hai; is kshetra me pahadon se aane wale tez barsaati nale kankad (bajri) tatha bhaari mitti jamate hain, isliye yahan ki mitti aam taur par khatti (acidic) tatha daldali hoti hai. Kisan is mitti ko sudharne ke liye khet me agricultural chuna (lime) milate hain, taaki khattapan kam ho tatha fasal khad (nutrients) sokh sake. Isi kshetra ke paas Someshwar pahadi tatha Valmiki tiger landscape ki foothill patti hai, jahan ghana jungle tatha nami wala mahaul milta hai. 'Khadar' naveen jalooh zameen hai (jaise Kosi kshetra), 'tal' paani bharne wale nicha kshetra hain (jaise Mokama), tatha 'balthar' dakshin Bihar ke plateau kinare ki lal-pili kankari mitti hai - teeno Dun se alag bhoogolik sthitiyaan hain. Isliye is prashn ka sahi uttar 'Dun' hai. Exam point: Dun = West Champaran me Shivalik foothills ke neeche sankra ghati-kshetra, kankad-mitti tatha acidic mitti; lime daal kar sudhara jaata hai.

qe: Which district of Bihar has the largest forest cover in terms of area, as per India State of Forest Report data?
qh: भारत वन स्थिति रिपोर्ट के आंकड़ों के अनुसार बिहार में क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से सर्वाधिक वन-क्षेत्र किस जिले में है?
e: Bihar me kul bhumi-kshetra ke lagbhag 7.8 pratishat hisse par jungle hai, jo rashtriya ausat se bahut kam hai; isliye Bihar ko 'van-rakshan' ke maamle me vishesh dhyan dena padta hai. Kshetrafal ki drishti se West Champaran jile me sabse zyada van-kshetra hai, kyunki yahan Valmiki Tiger Reserve ka vishal landscape Nepal seema ki taraf phaila hua hai. Isi tarah Kaimur, Rohtas tatha Jamui bhi bade van-kshetra wale jile hain, lekin aakdon me West Champaran aage rehta hai; yad rakhna ki van-pratishat (percentage) ke maamle me Jamui ya Kaimur jaisi sthiti ho sakti hai, kyunki Jab West Champaran ka kshetrafal bada hai, tab uska percentage alag aa sakta hai. Nalanda ke jungle chhote hain, isliye woh sahi vikalp nahi. Isi tarah ke prashnon me 'bihar me sabse zyada jungle wala jila' ka uttar West Champaran tatha 'rajya ka kul van-pratishat lagbhag 7.8' yaad rakhein. Exam point: van-kshetra (area) me pratham jila = West Champaran (Valmiki landscape); Bihar me jungle rajya-kshetra ka lagbhag 7.8 pratishat hi hai.

qe: Karkatgarh waterfall, where Bihar's first Crocodile Conservation Reserve has been set up, is formed on which river?
qh: बिहार का पहला मगरमच्छ संरक्षण क्षेत्र जहाँ स्थापित किया गया, वह करकटगढ़ जलप्रपात किस नदी पर बनता है?
e: Karkatgarh jalprapat Kaimur jile (Chainpur block) me Karmanasa nadi par banta hai, jab yah Vindhyan patthar ki khadi chattan se girti hai. Iski unchai lagbhag 100 foot hai, lekin uski khaas baat iski chaudai hai - paani horseshoe (ghode ki naal) jaisa phail kar girta hai, isliye ise kabhi-kabhi 'miniature Niagara' kaha jaata hai. Bihar sarkar ne isi kshetra me Bihar ka pehla Crocodile Conservation Reserve ghoshit kiya, jahan magarmachh (crocodile) ke sanrakshan tatha unki sankhya badhane par kaam hota hai; yah Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary ke core forest kshetra me hai. Durgavati nadi Karmanasa ki sahayak hai tatha Kaimur-Rohtas kshetra me behti hai; Suara nadi Telhar Kund ke jal-girah se judi hai; Falgu nadi Gaya kshetra ki mauwsmi nadi hai. Isliye Karkatgarh ke liye 'Karmanasa' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Karkatgarh jalprapat = Kaimur jila, Karmanasa nadi, lagbhag 100 foot uncha horseshoe waterfall tatha Bihar ka pehla Crocodile Conservation Reserve.

qe: Which river of Bihar is popularly called the 'Sorrow of Bihar' (Bihar ka Shok)?
qh: बिहार की कौन-सी नदी लोकप्रिय रूप से 'बिहार का शोक' कहलाती है?
e: Kosi nadi ko 'Bihar ka Shok' kaha jaata hai kyunki yah apne raste ko baar-baar badalti hai aur North Bihar ke bade hisse me vinashakari baadh laati hai. Kosi Himalaya se aate hue bahut zyada mitti (sediment) laati hai aur apna path purab ki taraf badalti rehti hai; pichhle do sadiyon me yah karib 120 se 150 kilometre pashchim ki taraf khiski hai, jisse kai gaon aur kheti ki zameen nasht hui. Isi liye Kosi ko duniya me river avulsion ka classic udaharan maana jaata hai. Gandak aur Bagmati bhi Bihar me baadh laati hain, lekin 'Bihar ka Shok' ka khitab Kosi ko hi mila hai; Son nadi South Bihar se behti hai aur uski baadh ka asar alag hai. Vedic sahitya me Kosi ka naam 'Kaushiki' milta hai, jo Rishi Vishwamitra (Kaushik) se juda hai. Exam point: 'Bihar ka Shok' = Kosi; iska purana naam Kaushiki, Saptakoshi se banti hai aur apna path badalti rehti hai.

qe: The Kosi river is called 'Saptakoshi' because:
qh: कोसी नदी को 'सप्तकोसी' कहा जाता है क्योंकि -
oe: it has seven tributaries only inside the Bihar plains
it is formed by the merging of seven Himalayan streams such as Sun Kosi, Arun and Tamur
it crosses the Nepal border at seven different points
it flows through seven districts of Bihar
oh: इसकी सात सहायक नदियाँ केवल बिहार के मैदान में हैं
यह सूर्य कोसी, अरुण तथा तमूर जैसी सात हिमालयी धाराओं के मिलने से बनती है
यह सात भिन्न बिंदुओं पर नेपाल की सीमा पार करती है
यह बिहार के सात जिलों से बहती है
e: Kosi ko Saptakoshi isliye kehte hain kyunki yah saat Himalayi dharaon ke milne se banti hai - Sun Kosi, Arun, Tamur, Dudh Kosi, Bhote Kosi, Tama Kosi aur Indrawati. Ye saari dharaayein Tibet-Nepal ke trans-Himalayan kshetra se nikal kar Nepal me aapas me mil jaati hain aur Birpur (Bhimnagar) ke paas Bihar ke maidan me utarti hain. Yahi 'saat dharaon ka sangam' is nadi ki khaas pehchan hai. Bihar ke maidan me aane ke baad Kosi ki kuch sahayak nadiyan alag hain, lekin nam Saptakoshi un saat Himalayi dhaaraon ke karan pada hai, isliye 'sirf Bihar ke maidan ki saaton sahayak' wala vikalp galat hai. Nepal ke saath seema paar karne ke sath saat bindu ya saat jile jaise aakde bhi kisi bhoogol-adhaar se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: Saptakoshi = Sun Kosi, Arun, Tamur, Dudh Kosi, Bhote Kosi, Tama Kosi aur Indrawati ke milan se banti hai; Bihar me yah Birpur/Bhimnagar ke paas utarti hai.

qe: The Indo-Nepal Kosi Barrage, which regulates the Kosi floods, is located at:
qh: कोसी की बाढ़ नियंत्रित करने वाला भारत-नेपाल कोसी बैराज स्थित है -
e: Kosi ko niyantrit karne ke liye 1950 ke dashak me Bharat-Nepal milkar Bhimnagar (Birpur, Supaul) ke paas Kosi Barrage banaye; isme lagbhag 56 radial gates lage hain jo baadh ke samay paani ka bahav niyantrit karte hain. Yah barrage Indo-Nepal seema par sthit hai, isliye dono deshon ki sahmati se chalta hai. Kosi ka paani isi barrage se nikaal kar Western Kosi Canal tatha Eastern Kosi Canal dwara sinchai ki jaati hai. Baaki vikalp anya nadiyon par bane structures ke hain: Valmikinagar (Triveni) barrage Gandak par hai, Jainagar barrage Kamla par banaya gaya hai, aur Karmaiya barrage Nepal me Bagmati par hai - isliye woh Kosi se juda nahi hai. Yeh dhyaan rakhna zaroori hai ki Kosi Barrage Kosi par hai, Gandak Barrage par nahi; aksar vidyarthi dono ko mila dete hain. Exam point: Kosi Barrage = Bhimnagar, Birpur (Supaul), Indo-Nepal sahmati se, 56 gates; Gandak Barrage = Valmikinagar (Triveni).

qe: Which river is the longest river that flows entirely within the boundaries of Bihar, without forming an inter-state boundary?
qh: कौन-सी नदी पूर्णतः बिहार की सीमाओं के भीतर बहने वाली सबसे लंबी नदी है, जो किसी अंतर्राज्यीय सीमा का निर्माण नहीं करती?
e: Burhi Gandak nadi Bihar ki woh sabse lambi nadi hai jo poori tarah Bihar ke andar hi behti hai, lagbhag 320 kilometre; iska koi bhi hissa antarrajiya seema nahi banata. Yah West Champaran ke Chautarwa Chaur (Someshwar hills ke aas-paas) se nikal kar Bettiah, Motihari, Muzaffarpur, Samastipur tatha Khagaria se hokar Ganga me mil jaati hai. Iske upri bhaag me lokal naam 'Sikrahna' hai. Kosi tatha Gandak Himalaya-Nepal se aati hain, isliye woh seema-paar ki nadiyan hain tatha Bihar-Uttar Pradesh ya Bharat-Nepal seema se judi hain. Bagmati bhi Nepal se aati hai, isliye woh 'poori tarah Bihar ke andar' wali shart poori nahi karti. Iske alava Burhi Gandak ke paas koi bada dam ya reservoir nahi hai, isliye iski baadh-rok-thaam keval tatt-bandhon (embankments) se hoti hai. Exam point: sabse lambi nadi jo poori Bihar ke andar hai = Burhi Gandak (karib 320 km), upri bhaag me Sikrahna kehlati hai, Khagaria me Ganga me milti hai.

qe: In Vedic literature, which river of Bihar was known as 'Sadanira' and hosts the famous Sonpur cattle fair at its confluence with the Ganga?
qh: वैदिक साहित्य में बिहार की कौन-सी नदी 'सदानीरा' के नाम से जानी जाती थी तथा गंगा के संगम पर प्रसिद्ध सोनपुर पशु मेला लगता है?
e: Gandak nadi ko Vedic sahitya me 'Sadanira' kaha gaya hai; Shatapatha Brahmana me iska yahi naam milta hai. Prachin samay me yah Kosala (UP) tatha Videha (Mithila) raajyaon ke beech pavitra seema maani jaati thi. Aaj bhi Gandak Mithila ki Sanskritik jeevan-rekha hai. Ganga ke saath iske sangam par Sonpur (Harihar Kshetra) me prasiddh pashu mela lagta hai, jo Kartik Purnima ke aas-paas Bihar ka sabse bada pashu mela mana jaata hai. Sath hi Yahi nadi Nepal se 'Saligram' jaisi pavitra jal-raashi laati hai tatha Bihar-Uttar Pradesh ke beech karib 45 kilometre ki seema banati hai. Ghaghra tatha Mahananda Bihar ki anya nadiyan hain, lekin unhe Vedic Sadanira nahi kaha jaata; Punpun South Bihar ki chhoti nadi hai. Isliye is prashn ka sahi jawab Gandak hai. Exam point: Vedic 'Sadanira' = Gandak; Sonpur pashu mela Gandak-Ganga sangam par (Harihar Kshetra), Valmikinagar/Triveni barrage bhi Gandak par.

qe: The Bagmati river, on whose bank the Pashupatinath temple of Kathmandu stands, enters the plains of Bihar at:
qh: काठमांडू का पशुपतिनाथ मंदिर जिस नदी के तट पर है, वह बागमती नदी बिहार के मैदान में कहाँ प्रवेश करती है?
e: Bagmati nadi Nepal ke Kathmandu valley me Shivapuri range ke 'Bagdwar' se nikalati hai; isi ke tat par prasiddh Pashupatinath mandir sthit hai, isliye Nepal me yah pavitra nadi maani jaati hai. Bharat me yah Sitamarhi jile ke 'Dheng' naam ke sthan se maidan me utarti hai aur aage Sitamarhi, Sheohar, Muzaffarpur, Darbhanga tatha Khagaria hote hue Ganga me mil jaati hai. Nepal ki pahadiyon me cloudburst hone par iska paani ghanton me hi maidan me pahunch jaata hai, isliye yah 'Sorrow of Sitamarhi tatha Sheohar' kahlati hai. Valmikinagar Gandak ka tatha Bhimnagar Kosi ka pravesh-sthal hai; Jainagar woh jagah hai jahan Kamla nadi Madhubani me Bihar me aati hai - isliye teeno vikalp anya nadiyon se jude hain. Baadh-rok-thaam ke liye Bihar ne nepal ke Karmaiya me barrage tatha Belwa Dhar diversion jaisi yojnaayein banai hain. Exam point: Bagmati ka udgam = Bagdwar (Kathmandu valley), Pashupatinath mandir isi ke tat par; Bihar me pravesh = Dheng (Sitamarhi).

qe: Which is the easternmost left-bank tributary of the Ganga in Bihar, whose basin includes Kishanganj, the rainiest district of Bihar?
qh: बिहार में गंगा की सबसे पूर्वी बायें तट की सहायक नदी कौन-सी है, जिसके बेसिन में बिहार का सर्वाधिक वर्षा वाला जिला किशनगंज आता है?
e: Mahananda Bihar me Ganga ki sabse purabi (easternmost) bayen tat ki sahayak nadi hai. Iska udgam West Bengal ke Darjeeling jile ke Paglajhora falls (Mahaldiram range) ke paas hai; yah Siliguri corridor se hokar Kishanganj me Bihar me aati hai. Mahananda basin me monsoonal barsaat bahut zyada hoti hai - Kishanganj me saalana barsaat 1800 millimetre se bhi zyada hoti hai, jo Bihar me sabse adhik hai; isliye yahan chai tatha jute jaise nam-vaalee fasalon ke liye anukool mahaul milta hai. Iske saath Kankai tatha Mechi nadiyan iski dayen tat ki sahayak hain; Mechi Bharat-Nepal ke beech seema-rekha ka kaam bhi karti hai. Kosi tatha Ghaghra bayen tat ki sahayak hain par sabse purabi nahi; Kamla Kosi gana ke madhya kshetra me behti hai. Kosi-Mechi river linking jaisi yojnayein bhi isi basin se judi hain. Exam point: Mahananda = Ganga ki sabse purabi bayen tat ki sahayak, udgam Paglajhora (Darjeeling), Kishanganj = Bihar ka sabse zyada varsha wala jila (1800 mm se adhik).

qe: Which river forms a part of the Bihar-Uttar Pradesh boundary and is traditionally known as the 'destroyer of religious merit'?
qh: कौन-सी नदी बिहार-उत्तर प्रदेश सीमा का एक भाग बनाती है तथा परंपरागत रूप से 'पुण्य नष्ट करने वाली' (कर्मनाशा) कहलाती है?
e: Karmanasa nadi ka naam hi do shabdon se bana hai - 'karma' tatha 'nasha', yaani karm ya punya ka nash karne wali. Lok-manas me maana jaata hai ki is nadi ka paani chhoone se punya nash ho jaata hai, isliye yah 'unholy river' kahlati hai. Yah Ganga ki dayen tat ki sahayak nadi hai aur Bihar-Uttar Pradesh ki seema-rekha ke ek bade hisse ka nirman karti hai; isi karan yah Bihar ke seema-nadiyon (Ghaghra, Gandak aur Karmanasa) ke samuh me gini jaati hai. Iska udgam Vindhyan kshetra (Peninsular) me hai, isliye yah barsaat par nirbhar (rainfed) hai. Son nadi bhi dayen tat ki sahayak hai lekin seema ke liye nahi jaani jaati; Punpun aur Falgu South Bihar ki chhoti tatha mauwsmi nadiyan hain jo Gaya-Patna ke aas-paas behti hain. Durgavati nadi Karmanasa ki sahayak hai, jo Kaimur-Rohtas ke plateau kshetra ko seenchti hai. Exam point: Karmanasa = Bihar-UP seema ki nadi, naam ka arth 'punya ka nash', Vindhyan kshetra se nikalati dayen tat ki sahayak; iski sahayak Durgavati hai.

qe: Which soil of north Bihar, known locally as Bangar or Doammat, is the most suitable for litchi cultivation?
qh: उत्तर बिहार की कौन-सी मिट्टी, जिसे स्थानीय रूप से बांगर या दोमट कहा जाता है, लीची की खेती के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त है?
e: Bal-Sundari mitti (jise Bangar, Chunedaar mitti ya Doammat bhi kehte hain) north Bihar ki purani jalooh (old alluvium) mitti hai, jo Muzaffarpur, Vaishali, Samastipur, Darbhanga, Saran tatha Siwan jaise jilon me milti hai. Is mitti me chuna (calcium) tatha potash ki matra achhi hoti hai aur paani ka nikas bhi theek rehta hai, isliye yah litchi tatha aam jaise bagaani faslon ke liye bahut upyukt hai. Muzaffarpur ki prasiddh 'Shahi Litchi' isi mitti ki den maani jaati hai. Khadar (naveen jalooh) mitti north-east Bihar ke Kosi-Seemanchal kshetra me hai jahan baadh ke karan nayi mitti jama hoti rehti hai; Balthar lal-pili mitti dakshin plateau kshetra ki hai tatha Karail-Kewal bhaari chikni mitti South Bihar maidan ki hai - isliye woh teeno litchi ke liye adarsh nahi maani jaati. Exam point: litchi ke liye sabse upyukt mitti = Bal-Sundari (Bangar/Doammat), north Bihar; Muzaffarpur ka Shahi Litchi isi mitti se juda hai.

qe: The Khadar (new alluvium) soil of Bihar, also called Diara or Kaap soil, is mainly found in which region?
qh: बिहार की खादर (नवीन जलोढ़) मिट्टी, जिसे दियारा या काप मिट्टी भी कहते हैं, मुख्यतः किस क्षेत्र में मिलती है?
oe: North-east Bihar plain, including Saharsa, Madhepura, Khagaria, Katihar and Purnea
Southern plateau margin, including Kaimur, Rohtas and Nawada
South Bihar plain, including Patna, Gaya and Bhojpur
oh: उत्तर-पूर्वी बिहार का मैदान, जिसमें सहरसा, मधेपुरा, खगड़िया, कटिहार तथा पूर्णिया शामिल हैं
दक्षिणी पठारी किनारा, जिसमें कैमूर, रोहतास तथा नवादा शामिल हैं
केवल पश्चिम चंपारण का तराई क्षेत्र
दक्षिण बिहार मैदान, जिसमें पटना, गया तथा भोजपुर शामिल हैं
e: Khadar mitti naveen jalooh (new alluvium) hai, jo nadiyon dwara laayi gayi nayi mitti se banti hai; ise Diara ya Kaap mitti bhi kehte hain. Bihar me yah mitti mukhyatah uttar-purabi maidan me milti hai - Saharsa, Madhepura, Khagaria, Katihar, Purnea, Begusarai tatha Samastipur jaise jile isi kshetra me aate hain. Yah mitti har saal Kosi tatha anya nadiyon ki baadh se nayi ho jaati hai, isliye isme poshak tatva achhe hote hain aur yah dhan (rice), makka, jute tatha patsan jaisi faslon ke liye upyukt hoti hai. Iska nuksaan bhi yahi hai ki baadh ise khet se baha le jaati hai. Dakshin plateau kinare ki Balthar mitti, South Bihar maidan ki Karail-Kewal mitti tatha West Champaran ke terai-daldali kshetra alag prakar ki mitti hain, isliye woh Khadar ke sahi kshetra nahi hain. Exam point: Khadar (navin jalooh/Diara) = uttar-purabi Bihar maidan (Kosi-Seemanchal belt), dhan-makka-jute ke liye upyukt.

qe: The heavy clayey soil of the South Bihar plain, known locally as Karail mitti, is best described as:
qh: दक्षिण बिहार मैदान की भारी चिकनी मिट्टी, जिसे स्थानीय रूप से करैल मिट्टी कहते हैं, सर्वोत्तम रूप से कैसे वर्णित की जा सकती है?
oe: Old alluvium of the South Bihar plain with high clay content, found in Rohtas, Kaimur, Buxar, Bhojpur, Patna and Gaya
A sandy desert soil of the Thar type
New alluvium brought every year by the Kosi floods
Laterite soil of the Chotanagpur region with heavy iron content
oh: दक्षिण बिहार मैदान की पुरानी जलोढ़ मिट्टी, जिसमें चिकनी मिट्टी की मात्रा अधिक होती है; रोहतास, कैमूर, बुक्सर, भोजपुर, पटना तथा गया में मिलती है
कोसी की बाढ़ से प्रतिवर्ष आने वाली नवीन जलोढ़
छोटानागपुर क्षेत्र की भारी लौह-युक्त लेटेराइट मिट्टी
e: Karail tatha Kewal mitti South Bihar maidan ki purani jalooh (old alluvium) hai jisme chikni mitti (clay) ka hissa adhik hota hai, isliye yah bhaari mitti kehlati hai. Yah Rohtas, Kaimur, Buxar, Bhojpur, Patna, Jehanabad, Aurangabad tatha Gaya jaise jilon me milti hai. Iski khaas baat yah hai ki paani ko rok kar rakhne ki kshamta zyada hoti hai, lekin nikalne (drainage) me dikkat aati hai; isliye barsaat zyada hone par kheti me paani bhar sakta hai aur sukhne par mitti kadak ho jaati hai. Yah mitti chawal tatha gehun ke liye theek hoti hai par isme jaivik padarth badhane ki zaroorat padti hai. Thar jaisi baluee mitti, Kosi ki baadh wali naveen jalooh (Khadar) tatha Chotanagpur ki laterite mitti is prashn ke varnan se mel nahi khaate, isliye woh vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Karail-Kewal = South Bihar maidan ki purani jalooh bhaari clay mitti (Rohtas, Kaimur, Buxar, Bhojpur, Patna, Gaya); paani rokne ki kshamta adhik, nikas kam.

qe: The red-yellow soil of the southern plateau margin of Bihar, called Balthar, is found mainly in which districts?
qh: बिहार के दक्षिणी पठारी किनारे की लाल-पीली मिट्टी, जिसे बलथर कहते हैं, मुख्यतः किन जिलों में मिलती है?
oe: Kaimur, Rohtas, Aurangabad, Gaya, Nawada, Jamui and Banka
Saharsa, Madhepura, Khagaria, Katihar and Purnea
West Champaran, East Champaran and Sitamarhi
oh: कैमूर, रोहतास, औरंगाबाद, गया, नवादा, जमुई तथा बांका
सहरसा, मधेपुरा, खगड़िया, कटिहार तथा पूर्णिया
पश्चिम चंपारण, पूर्वी चंपारण तथा सीतामढ़ी
e: Balthar mitti Bihar ke dakshini plateau kinare (southern plateau margin) ki lal-pili mitti hai, jisme kankar tatha pathrilapan (kankari) adhik hota hai. Yah Kaimur, Rohtas, Aurangabad, Gaya, Nawada, Jamui tatha Banka jaise jilon me milti hai - yaani jahan Chotanagpur plateau tatha Vindhyan kshetra ka kinara Bihar ke maidan se milta hai. Is mitti me jaivik padarth (organic matter) kam hota hai, paani rokne ki kshamta bhi kam hoti hai aur dhalwan (slope) zameen hone se apkashan (erosion) tez hoti hai; isliye yahan sinchai tatha mitti-samrakshan ke kary bahut zaroori hote hain. Yah kshetra dalhan tatha telahan faslon, chhote anaaj tatha falon ke liye upyukt hai. Saharsa-Madhepura-Khagaria-Purnea Khadar (naveen jalooh) ka kshetra hai, West Champaran terai-daldali kshetra hai tatha Muzaffarpur-Vaishali-Saran-Sivan Bal-Sundari mitti ka kshetra hai - isliye baaki teeno vikalp Balthar ke sahi jile nahi hain. Exam point: Balthar (lal-pili, kankariya mitti) = dakshini plateau kinara - Kaimur, Rohtas, Aurangabad, Gaya, Nawada, Jamui, Banka.

qe: In Bihar's agro-climatic classification, which zone covers the largest number of districts?
qh: बिहार के कृषि-जलवायु वर्गीकरण में किस क्षेत्र (zone) में सर्वाधिक जिले आते हैं?
oe: All the zones have an equal number of districts
oh: सभी क्षेत्रों में जिलों की संख्या समान है
e: Bihar ko krishi-jalvayu ke aadhaar par mukhya roop se teen zones me baanta jaata hai. Zone I uttar-pashchimi jalooh maidan hai jisme lagbhag 13 jile aate hain (West Champaran, East Champaran, Sheohar, Sitamarhi, Madhubani, Saran, Siwan, Gopalganj, Muzaffarpur, Vaishali, Samastipur, Darbhanga tatha Begusarai jaise jile). Zone II uttar-purabi jalooh maidan hai jisme lagbhag 8 jile hain (Supaul, Saharsa, Madhepura, Purnea, Kishanganj, Araria, Katihar tatha Khagaria). Zone III dakshin Bihar jalooh maidan hai, jise aage IIIA (dakshin-purba, 6 jile) tatha IIIB (dakshin-pashchim, 11 jile) me baanta jaata hai - is tarah Zone III me kul 17 jile aate hain, jo sabse adhik hai. Isliye sabse bade kshetr Zone III hai. Is vargikaran ka upyog fasal-chayan, sinchai planning tatha krishi-vikas yojnaon me hota hai. Exam point: Bihar ke teen agro-climatic zones - Zone I (NW alluvial) karib 13 jile, Zone II (NE alluvial) karib 8 jile, Zone III (South Bihar alluvial) karib 17 jile (IIIA 6 tatha IIIB 11) - sabse bada Zone III.

qe: Which district of Bihar ranks first in the production of rice (paddy)?
qh: बिहार में धान (rice) के उत्पादन में कौन-सा जिला प्रथम स्थान पर है?
e: Bihar ki sabse badi khadyan fasal dhan (rice) hai aur utpadan ke maamle me Rohtas jila pratham sthan par rehta hai. Iska karan yah hai ki Rohtas me Sone nadi ke command kshetra ki achhi sinchai tatha Kaimur-Rohtas ki mitti-jalvayu ka anukool sangam milta hai. Dhan ki kheti ke liye zyada paani tatha garam-nam mausam chahiye hota hai, isliye Bihar me yah Kharif ki mukhya fasal hai. Dhan ka kul utpadan Bihar me sabse zyada hota hai aur iske baad makka tatha gehun aate hain. Dhan ke saath-saath Bihar me tootay chawal (broken rice) se grain-based ethanol banane ka rujhaan bhi badh raha hai, jisse is fasal ki maang aur badhi hai. Madhubani, Patna tatha Nalanda anya mahatvapurn krishi jile hain, lekin dhan ke utpadan me woh Rohtas se aage nahi hain. Exam point: Bihar me dhan (paddy) utpadan me pratham jila = Rohtas (Sone command kshetra ki sinhchai ka laabh).

qe: Which district of Bihar is popularly called the 'Maize Bowl of Bihar'?
qh: बिहार का कौन-सा जिला लोकप्रिय रूप से 'बिहार का मक्का-कटोरा' (Maize Bowl) कहलाता है?
e: Khagaria jila Bihar me sabse adhik makka utpadan tatha prati hectare paidawar ke liye jaana jaata hai, isliye ise 'Maize Bowl of Bihar' kaha jaata hai. Makka Bihar ki woh khaas fasal hai jo Kharif, Rabi tatha Zaid - teeno mausam me ugayi ja sakti hai, lekin sabse achhi paidawar Rabi makka (October-November ki boyai tatha April-May ki katai) deti hai. Utpadan ke kul aakdon me Katihar tatha Purnea bhi sabse aage hain, isliye parikshaon me 'Kosi-Seemanchal kshetra (Katihar, Purnea, Khagaria)' ka jikra aata hai. Makka ka itna mahatva isliye bhi badha hai kyunki Bihar Ethanol Production Promotion Policy ke tehat Purnea me Bharat ka pehla grain-based (anaj-adharit) ethanol plant makke par sthapit kiya gaya, jisse kisanon ko naya bazaar mila. Rohtas dhan-gehun ka, Muzaffarpur litchi ka tatha West Champaran ganne ka prasiddh kshetra hai. Exam point: 'Maize Bowl of Bihar' = Khagaria; makka utpadan me aage - Katihar, Purnea, Khagaria; Purnea me desh ka pehla grain-based ethanol plant.

qe: Which district of Bihar alone produces more than half of the state's sugarcane?
qh: बिहार में अकेले कौन-सा जिला राज्य के आधे से अधिक गन्ने का उत्पादन करता है?
e: Ganna Bihar ki sabse badi nakit (cash) fasal hai aur iske utpadan me West Champaran jila akele rajya ke ganne ka aadhe se adhik hissa paida karta hai, isliye ise Bihar ki 'sugar bowl' bhi kaha ja sakta hai. Ganna ek varshik fasal hai jise pakne me lagbhag 10 se 12 mahine lagte hain; iske liye garam tatha nam jalvayu (20 se 35 degree Celsius tatha achhi barsaat ya sinchai) chahiye hoti hai. West Champaran me Harinagar, Narkatiaganj, Majhaulia tatha Sidhwalia jaise cheeni (sugar) millen is kshetra ki industrial jeevan-rekha hain; inhi millon se judi distillery molasses tatha ganne ke ras se ethanol banati hain, jo petrol me milane (blending) ke kaam aata hai. Gopalganj tatha East Champaran bhi ganne ke mahatvapurn jile hain, lekin utpadan me woh West Champaran se peeche hain; Sitamarhi is fasal ka pramukh kshetra nahi hai. Exam point: ganne ke utpadan me Bihar me pratham jila = West Champaran (50% se adhik), aur cheeni udyog ka mukhya kshetra Tirhut-Saran prabhag hai.

qe: Bihar's Mithilanchal region accounts for roughly what share of the world's makhana (fox nut) production, and where is the National Research Centre for Makhana located?
qh: बिहार का मिथिलांचल क्षेत्र विश्व के मखाना उत्पादन में लगभग कितना हिस्सा रखता है, और मखाना का राष्ट्रीय अनुसंधान केंद्र कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Makhana (Euryale ferox) ek jaliya (aquatic) fasal hai jo 3 se 5 foot gehre shant talabon, dhabon tatha chaurs me ugti hai; Mithilanchal - mukhya roop se Darbhanga tatha Madhubani - vishwa ke kul makhana utpadan ka lagbhag 85 se 90 pratishat hissa paida karta hai. Makhana ko 'superfood' kaha jaata hai kyunki isme protein, calcium tatha anti-oxidant achhi matra me hote hain, isliye iski maang videsh me tezi se badhi hai. Isi kshetra ke liye 'Mithila Makhana' ko GI tag bhi mila hai, jisse iski pehchan vishwastariya hui. Kisanon ki mehnat kam karne ke liye mechanical popping tatha grading machines bhi vikasit ki gayi hain, aur ICAR ka National Research Centre for Makhana Darbhanga me sthit hai - isi wajah se is prashn ka sahi jawab Darbhanga hai. Patna, Muzaffarpur tatha Purnea makhana ke mukhya utpadan kendra nahi hain, isliye woh vikalp galat hain. Exam point: makhana utpadan me Mithilanchal ka hissa vishwa me lagbhag 85-90%, NRC for Makhana = Darbhanga; 'Mithila Makhana' ko GI tag prapt.

qe: Which is the only national park and the only tiger reserve of Bihar?
qh: बिहार का एकमात्र राष्ट्रीय उद्यान तथा एकमात्र टाइगर रिजर्व कौन-सा है?
oe: Valmiki National Park and Tiger Reserve, West Champaran
oh: वाल्मीकि राष्ट्रीय उद्यान व टाइगर रिजर्व, पश्चिम चंपारण
e: Valmiki hi Bihar ka ekmatra rashtriya udyan tatha ekmatra tiger reserve hai; yah rajya ke uttar-pashchim kone me Nepal seema ke paas West Champaran jile me sthit hai. Yahan Shivalik ki foothills, Bhabar-Terai kshetra, ghaas ke maidan tatha nadiya ek saath milti hain, isliye tiger ke liye upyukt mahaul banta hai; Gandak, Pandai, Harha, Masan tatha Manor nadiyan isi kshetra me behti hain. Iski sthapna ke charan yah hain - 1978 me Valmiki Wildlife Sanctuary, 1990 me Valmiki National Park tatha 2012 me Valmiki Tiger Reserve ke roop me rakshit kshetra sammilit hue; national park kshetra lagbhag 335 square kilometre tatha tiger reserve lagbhag 899 square kilometre me faila hai. Yahan Royal Bengal Tiger ke saath leopard, gaur, sloth bear, sambar tatha chital bhi milte hain. Kaimur, Bhimbandh tatha Kanwar keval wildlife sanctuary ya bird sanctuary hain, national park nahi - isliye woh sahi vikalp nahi hain. Exam point: Bihar ka ekmatra rashtriya udyan tatha tiger reserve = Valmiki (West Champaran); 1978 sanctuary, 1990 national park, 2012 tiger reserve; Nepal seema se juda.

qe: Which is the largest wildlife sanctuary of Bihar, spread over about 1,505 square kilometres in the Kaimur plateau?
qh: कैमूर पठार में लगभग 1,505 वर्ग किलोमीटर में फैला बिहार का सबसे बड़ा वन्यजीव अभयारण्य कौन-सा है?
e: Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary Bihar ka sabse bada van rajya kshetra hai, jo lagbhag 1,505 square kilometre me Kaimur tatha Rohtas jilon me faila hai. Yah kshetra Kaimur pahadi (Vindhyan range) ke dhalwan, khadi chattanon, seasonal nadiyon tatha sookhe patjhad ke jungle se bana hai; Karkatgarh tatha Telhar jaise jalprapat bhi isi landscape ka hissa hain. Yahan chinkara (jise khuli chattani zameen pasand hai), leopard, sloth bear, sambar, nilgai tatha hyena jaise jeev milte hain; kyunki pata zameen par chaaron taraf khula hain, isliye yah Bihar me tiger-reserve vistar ki sambhavna wala kshetra bhi maana jaata hai. Bhimbandh (Munger, lagbhag 682 square kilometre), Valmiki (West Champaran) tatha Gautam Buddha (Gaya, lagbhag 138 square kilometre) isse chhote hain, isliye woh vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Bihar ka sabse bada van rajya kshetra = Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary (lagbhag 1,505 square kilometre, Kaimur-Rohtas belt); Telhar tatha Karkatgarh jalprapat isi landscape me.

qe: Bhimbandh Wildlife Sanctuary, known for its hot-water springs, is located in which district and hilly range?
qh: गर्म जल-स्रोतों के लिए प्रसिद्ध भीमबांध वन्यजीव अभयारण्य किस जिले तथा पहाड़ी श्रेणी में स्थित है?
e: Bhimbandh Wildlife Sanctuary Munger jile ki Kharagpur Hills me sthit hai aur iska kshetra lagbhag 682 square kilometre hai; ise 27 May 1976 ko notified kiya gaya tha. Yahan ghaney patjhad ke jungle, ghaatiyan, mauwsmi nadiyan tatha garm jal-kund milte hain - Bhimbandh, Sita Kund tatha Rishi Kund is kshetra ke mukhya jal-srot hain, jinme paani zameen ke geheri fault lines se garam hokar nikalta hai. Yahi karan hai ki yahan ka paani thand ke mausam me bhi garam rehta hai tatha unka chikitsiya (medicinal) mahtv bataya jaata hai. Jungle me leopard, sloth bear, sambar, chital tatha nilgai milte hain. Rajgir Hills tatha Rajgir WLS Nalanda me hain, Rajauli WLS Nawada me Koderma plateau ke kinare hai tatha Kaimur WLS Vindhyan kshetra me - isliye Bhimbandh ke liye Munger aur Kharagpur Hills sahi jodi hai. Exam point: Bhimbandh WLS = Munger, Kharagpur Hills, 1976 me notified; hot springs - Bhimbandh, Sita Kund tatha Rishi Kund; area lagbhag 682 square kilometre.

qe: Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary, India's only sanctuary created specially for the Gangetic dolphin, covers which river stretch?
qh: गंगा डॉल्फिन के लिए विशेष रूप से बना भारत का एकमात्र अभयारण्य विक्रमशिला गांगेय डॉल्फिन अभयारण्य किस नदी-खंड को समेटता है?
oe: The Ganga from Sultanganj to Kahalgaon in Bhagalpur
The Gandak from Valmikinagar to Hajipur
The Kosi from Birpur to Kursela
The Son from Dehri to Patna
oh: भागलपुर में सुल्तानगंज से कहलगांव तक गंगा
e: Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary 1990 me banaya gaya aur yah bharat ka ekmatra aisa sanctuary hai jo sirf Gangetic dolphin (Ganga me paayi jaane wali dolphin) ke sanrakshan ke liye banaya gaya. Yah Bhagalpur jile me Ganga nadi ke lagbhag 60 kilometre lambe khund par faila hai, jo Sultanganj se Kahalgaon tak jaata hai. Ganga dolphin (Platanista gangetica) ek staniya (mammal) jeev hai jo paani me rehta hai par saans lene ke liye satah par aata hai; iski aankhein bahut kamjor hoti hain aur woh 'echolocation' (dhwani ki goonj se disha pehchanna) se shikar karti hai. Yah bharat ka rashtriya jal-char (national aquatic animal) hai tatha IUCN ki list me 'endangered' shreni me hai; iska sanrakshan Ganga ki safai aur machhli-maar rokne se juda hai. Gandak, Kosi tatha Son ke diye gaye khund is sanctuary ka hissa nahi hain, isliye 'Sultanganj se Kahalgaon (Bhagalpur)' hi sahi hai. Exam point: Vikramshila Dolphin Sanctuary = Bhagalpur, Ganga ka Sultanganj-Kahalgaon stretch (lagbhag 60 km), 1990 me sthapit, bharat ka ekmatra dolphin sanctuary; Ganga dolphin rashtriya jal-char tatha endangered.

qe: Kanwar Jheel (Kabartal) in Begusarai, Bihar's first Ramsar site, is an example of which type of lake?
qh: बिहार की पहली रामसर साइट, बेगूसराय की कांवर झील (काबरताल) किस प्रकार की झील का उदाहरण है?
oe: Oxbow lake formed by the meandering of the Burhi Gandak
Crater lake formed by a volcano
Glacial lake formed by a melting glacier
oh: बूढ़ी गंडक के विसर्पण से बनी छाड़न (oxbow) झील
ग्लेशियर पिघलने से बना हिम झील
सिंचाई के लिए बना कृत्रिम जलाशय
e: Kanwar Jheel, jise Kabar Taal bhi kehte hain, Begusarai jile ke Manjhaul kshetra me Burhi Gandak nadi ke bassein me sthit hai. Yah 'oxbow' jheel hai, yaani jab nadi apna rasta badalti hai to uske puraane mod ka hissa alag reh jaata hai aur wahan paani bhar jaata hai; aise jheel ko chhaadan jheel bhi kehte hain. Kanwar ko Asia ki sabse badi meethe paani ki (freshwater) oxbow jheel maana jaata hai tatha iski gehrai aam taur par sirf 1 se 3 meter tak hoti hai. Isse July 2020 me Ramsar site (Site No. 2436) ka darja mila, isliye yah Bihar ki pehli Ramsar site bani; thand ke mausam me Siberia, Central Asia tatha Mongolia se sainkdon prajatiyan yahan aati hain. Crater lake, glacial lake tatha artificial reservoir anya prakar ki jheelon ke udaharan hain tatha Kanwar inme nahi aati, isliye baaki vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Kanwar Jheel/Kabartal = Begusarai, Burhi Gandak ke meandering se bani oxbow jheel, Asia ki sabse badi freshwater oxbow jheel; 2020 me Bihar ki pehli Ramsar site.

qe: Nagi and Nakti bird sanctuaries, designated as Ramsar sites in 2024, are located in which district famous for the bar-headed goose?
qh: 2024 में रामसर साइट घोषित नागी तथा नकटी पक्षी अभयारण्य किस जिले में हैं, जहाँ सिर-धारी हंस (bar-headed goose) आती है?
e: Nagi tatha Nakti bird sanctuaries Jamui jile ke Jhajha forest range me hain; dono man-made (manushya-nirmit) reservoir hain jo pehle sinchai tatha paani bharne ke liye banaye gaye the aur aaj bahut mahatvapurn pakshi-sthal ban gaye hain. Dono ko 1987 me bird sanctuary ghoshit kiya gaya tatha 5 June 2024 ko Ramsar site ka darja mila; us samay Nagi tatha Nakti India ki 81vein tatha 82vein Ramsar sites bani. Yahan thand ke mausam me Siberia aur Central Asia se pravasini pakshi aate hain; sabse khas 'bar-headed goose' hai, jo bahut unchi udaan bharne wali batakh maani jaati hai. Nagi ka Ramsar kshetra lagbhag 2 square kilometre tatha Nakti ka lagbhag 3.33 square kilometre hai. Katihar me Gogabil lake, Darbhanga me Kusheshwar Asthan tatha West Champaran me Udaipur Jheel tatha Valmiki kshetra hai, isliye baaki vikalp anya sthalon ke hain. Exam point: Nagi tatha Nakti bird sanctuaries = Jamui (Jhajha forest range), 1987 me sanctuary, 2024 me Ramsar sites; bar-headed goose inki khas pravasini pakshi hai.

qe: Which two sites in Bihar are inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List?
qh: बिहार के कौन-से दो स्थल यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर सूची में शामिल हैं?
oe: Mahabodhi Temple Complex, Bodh Gaya and Nalanda Mahavihara
Mahabodhi Temple Complex and Kesariya Stupa
Barabar Caves and Mahabodhi Temple Complex
oh: बोधगया का महाबोधि मंदिर परिसर तथा नालंदा महाविहार
महाबोधि मंदिर परिसर तथा केसरिया स्तूप
बराबर की गुफाएँ तथा महाबोधि मंदिर परिसर
e: Bihar ke do sthal UNESCO ki vishva dharohar soochi me shaamil hain. Pehla - Mahabodhi Temple Complex, Bodh Gaya (Gaya jila), jahan Siddhartha Gautama ko peepal ke ped ke neeche gyan (nirvana) prapt hua; iska mool mandir samrat Ashoka ne banwaya tatha aaj ka bada eenton ka shikhara mandir Gupta kaal me viksit hua. Ise 2002 me World Heritage Site ghoshit kiya gaya. Doosra - Nalanda Mahavihara (Nalanda jila), duniya ka pehla bada avasiya antarrashtriya vishwavidyalaya, jise Kumargupta I ne sthapit kiya; iske khandaher aaj Bihar Sharif ke nikat Bada Gaon me hain aur 2016 me UNESCO ne ise World Heritage Site banaya. Vikramshila (Antichak, Bhagalpur), Kesariya stupa (East Champaran) tatha Barabar caves (Jehanabad) mahatvapurn ASI-protected tatha UNESCO tentative-list wale sthal hain, lekin abhi unhe sthapit dharohar ka darja nahi mila, isliye woh vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Bihar ki do UNESCO World Heritage Sites = Mahabodhi Temple (Bodh Gaya, 2002) tatha Nalanda Mahavihara (2016); Kesariya tatha Barabar tentative list me hain.

qe: Which famous waterfall of Bihar is located in Nawada district and is associated with the Baisakhi fair?
qh: बिहार का कौन-सा प्रसिद्ध जलप्रपात नवादा जिले में स्थित है तथा वैशाखी मेले से जुड़ा है?
e: Kakolat jalprapat Nawada jile ke Govindpur block ki Kakolat pahadi se girta hai; yah lagbhag 150 se 160 foot unchi granite chattan se seedha ek gehere kund me girta hai. Kaha jaata hai ki iska paani saal bhar thanda tatha sheetal rehta hai, isliye garmi me yahan snan ka khaas mahatva hai. Chaiti Baisakhi tatha Vishua Sankranti ke avsar par yahan bada mela lagta hai tatha shradhalu pavitra snan karte hain. Telhar Kund tatha Karkatgarh jalprapat Kaimur jile me hain; Telhar lagbhag 260 se 280 foot uncha hai tatha Karkatgarh Karmanasa nadi par lagbhag 100 foot unchi horseshoe-shaped dhara banata hai, jahan Bihar ka pehla Crocodile Conservation Reserve sthapit kiya gaya. Dhua Kund tatha Manjhar Kund Kaimur kshetra ke anya jal-srot hain. Exam point: Kakolat jalprapat = Nawada (Govindpur block), lagbhag 150-160 foot, Baisakhi mela se juda; Telhar Kund tatha Karkatgarh = Kaimur jila (Karkatgarh par Bihar ka pehla Crocodile Conservation Reserve).

qe: Rajgir Zoo Safari, inaugurated in 2022 as Bihar's first zoo safari, and the first aviary of the state are located in which district?
qh: 2022 में बिहार के पहले जू सफारी के रूप में उद्घाटित राजगीर जू सफारी तथा राज्य की पहली एवियरी किस जिले में स्थित हैं?
e: Rajgir Zoo Safari Nalanda jile ke Rajgir hills me 191.12 hectare (lagbhag 1.91 square kilometre) me faila Bihar ka pehla zoo safari hai, jise 16 February 2022 ko udghatit kiya gaya. Yah aam chidiyaghar jaisa nahi hai; isme tiger, lion, leopard tatha bear ke liye alag zones tatha herbivore zone me chital, sambar, blackbuck, hog deer tatha nilgai ke liye khule-aakaran wale bade bada (natural-looking) enclosure hain, taaki pashu apne swabhavik mahaul me rahein. Isi Rajgir kshetra me March 2025 me Bihar ki pehli aviary bhi shuru ki gayi tatha Rajgir Nature Safari, glass sky walk tatha Rajgir Wildlife Sanctuary (Nalanda) jaisi suvidhaayein bhi vikasit hui hain. Gaya jile me Bodh Gaya tatha Gautam Buddha Wildlife Sanctuary hai, Patna rajdhani hai tatha Jehanabad me Barabar caves - isliye ye teen vikalp Rajgir ke sahi jile nahi hain. Exam point: Rajgir Zoo Safari (2022, Bihar ka pehla zoo safari) tatha Nature Safari (2021) = Nalanda jila; Bihar ki pehli aviary bhi Rajgir me; Rajgir Wildlife Sanctuary ka kshetra lagbhag 35.84 square kilometre.

qe: Which soil class of the district, a hard stiff clay that opens out when dry in gaping fissures, contained about seventy per cent of clay?
qh: जिले की कौन-सी मिट्टी कठोर चिपचिपी मिट्टी थी, जो सूखने पर चौड़ी दरारों में फट जाती थी तथा जिसमें लगभग सत्तर प्रतिशत चिकनी मिट्टी होती थी?
e: Zile ki mitti ko mukhyatah char vargon me baanta gaya - keval, doras, balsundri tatha diara bhoomi. Kewal mitti kathor tatha chipchipi mitti hoti hai, jisme lagbhag sattar pratishat chikni mitti hoti hai tatha sookhne par yah chaudi dararon me phat jaati hai. Ismein dhan ki kheti hoti hai, lekin yah rabi fasalon ke liye bhi upyukt hai, kyunki yah lamba samay tak nami rok kar rakhti hai tatha rabi ki fasal bahut had tak neeche ki mitti ki nami par nirbhar karti hai. Barh subdivision me kewal mitti ka ek roop tal land kehlata hai, jisme barsaat me itna paani bhar jaata hai ki dhan bhi nahi ho paata, lekin wahan rabi ki shandar fasalein hoti hain. Exam point: kewal mitti me lagbhag sattar pratishat chikni mitti hoti hai, yah sookhne par dararon me phat jaati hai tatha nami rok kar rakhne ke kaaran dhan tatha rabi dono ke liye upyukt hoti hai.

qe: The soil class called doras in the district consisted of what mixture?
qh: जिले में दोरस कहलाने वाली मिट्टी किन दो चीज़ों का मिश्रण थी?
oe: Pure river silt deposited every year
oh: हर वर्ष जमा शुद्ध नदी की गाद
आधी चिकनी मिट्टी तथा आधी रेत
e: Zile ki mitti ke vargikaran me doras mitti aadhi chikni mitti tatha aadhi ret se banti thi. Yah neeche wali jagahon par dhan tatha rabi fasalein deti thi, jabki unchi zameen par bhadoi tatha rabi fasalein, jaise makka tatha arhar, isse hoti thi. Doras mitti ka sabse amir roop bhitiy ya dih bhoomi kehlata tha, yaani gaon ke gharon ke aas-paas ki patti, jise door ki zameen se zyada khaad milti thi tatha zyada savdhani se jot-daat ki jaati thi. Yahan kuon se sinchai zyada hoti thi tatha sabse keemti fasalein, jaise masale, aalu tatha sabziyan, badi matra me ugayi jaati thi. Exam point: doras mitti aadhi chikni mitti tatha aadhi ret ka mishran thi; neeche wali jagah par dhan-rabi tatha unchi zameen par makka-arhar jaisi bhadoi-rabi fasalein hoti thi, aur iska sabse amir roop gaon ke paas ki dih bhoomi thi.

qe: Which soil class of the district was a sandy loam in which sand preponderated over clay, growing bhadoi and rabi crops such as marua and barley?
qh: जिले की कौन-सी मिट्टी रेतीली दोमट थी, जिसमें चिकनी मिट्टी से अधिक रेत होती थी तथा जिसमें मरुआ और जौ जैसी भदोई-रबी फ़सलें होती थीं?
e: Balsundri mitti retili domat hoti thi, jisme chikni mitti ki tulna me ret ki matra adhik hoti thi. Is mitti me bhadoi tatha rabi fasalein, jaise marua tatha jau, ugayi jaati thi. Diara bhoomi bhi doras ya balsundri hi hoti thi, aksar balsundri, lekin uski visheshta yah thi ki woh har saal nadi ki gadd se nayi upjao shakti paati thi. Diara bhoomi par bhi marua tatha jau jaisi hi fasalein hoti thi, lekin wahan sabse priya fasal arandi yaani castor-oil ka paudha tha. Is tarah mitti ke prakar tatha sinchai ki vyavastha milkar tay karte the ki kis kshetra me kaunsi fasal sabse achhi hogi. Exam point: balsundri mitti retili domat thi, jisme ret chikni mitti se adhik hoti thi tatha marua tatha jau jaisi bhadoi-rabi fasalein hoti thi; diara bhoomi par castor-oil ka paudha sabse priya fasal tha.

qe: The white soil called rehra was rendered more or less sterile by impregnation with which substance, and when the impregnation made it unculturable waste it was known as usar?
qh: रेहरा नामक सफ़ेद मिट्टी किस पदार्थ के मिश्रण से कमोबेश बंजर हो जाती थी, तथा जब यह मिश्रण उसे जोतने लायक न छोड़ता तो उसे उसर कहा जाता था?
e: Zile ki mitti ke chinh me ek safed mitti bhi shamil thi, jise rehra kaha jaata tha. Yah mitti reh yaani sodium carbonate ke mishran se kamobesh banjar ho jaati thi. Jab yah mishran itna badh jaata tha ki mitti jotne layak nahi bachti, to aisi banjar zameen ko usar kaha jaata tha. Islampur thana ki zameen zyadatar unchi tatha retili thi tatha kuch bhaag me aisi banjar mitti thi, jisme sodium carbonate mila hua tha; is kshetra ki kuch zamein sinchai ke sadhan bhi kho chuki thi, kyunki uski nadiyon ke channels gadd se bhar gaye the. Aise varnan se pata chalta hai ki mitti ki gunvatta tatha sinchai dono milkar krishi ki upjau shakti tay karte the. Exam point: rehra safed mitti sodium carbonate yaani reh ke mishran se banjar ho jaati thi tatha jab yah jotne layak na bache to use usar kaha jaata tha; Islampur thana me aisi banjar mitti mili thi.

qe: On the sufficiency of the rain of which month, more than of any other, depended the character of the winter rice crop of the district?
qh: जिले की जाड़े वाली धान की फ़सल की गुणवत्ता किस महीने की वर्षा की पर्याप्तता पर, अन्य किसी महीने से अधिक, निर्भर थी?
e: Krishi ke liye varsha ka satik vitaran bahut zaroori tha. Adarsh varsh me May ya June ke shuru me hone wali halki varsha se spade yaani phawde se khodai ka kaam aasan hota tha, jo hal chalane se pehle zaroori hota hai; June ke ant tatha July me varsha bhaari honi chahiye, jiske baad kuch samay mausam saaf rahe, taaki nirai yaani weeding ka kaam theek se ho sake. September ki varsha bhaari honi chahiye, jo Octomber ki halki varsha ke saath saaf mausam me badal jaye. Jile ki jade wali dhani ki fasal ki gunvatta, kisi bhi anya mahine se zyada, September ki varsha ki paryapta par nirbhar karti thi. Exam point: jadi wali dhani ki fasal September ki varsha ki paryapta par sabse zyada nirbhar thi; May-June ki halki varsha khodai, June-July ki bhaari varsha tatha uske baad saaf mausam nirai ke liye zaroori tha.

qe: Periodic showers from December to February inclusive were regarded as essential to which harvest of the district?
qh: दिसंबर से फ़रवरी तक आने वाली समय-समय की हल्की वर्षा जिले की किस फ़सल के लिए आवश्यक मानी जाती थी?
e: Zile me krishi ka poora kaam varsha ke samay-par-samay aane par nirbhar tha. May ya June ke shuru ki halki varsha se phawde se khodai hoti thi, June ke ant tatha July ki bhaari varsha se kheton me paani bhar jaata tha, uske baad saaf mausam me nirai hoti thi tatha September ki bhaari varsha winter rice tatha jade wali dhani ki fasal tay karti thi. Iske baad December se February tak samay-samay par hone wali halki varsha acchi rabi fasal ke liye aavashyak maani jaati thi, kyunki rabi ki fasal zyadatar mitti ki neeche ki nami tatha samay par mili halki varsha par nirbhar karti thi. Is tarah varash-vitaran hi jile ke krishi-kalendar ko tay karta tha. Exam point: December se February tak ki halki varsha acchi rabi fasal ke liye aavashyak thi, jabki September ki varsha jade wali dhani tatha June-July ki varsha bhadoi fasalon ke liye nirnayak thi.

qe: The cultivated area of the district was divided among aghani, rabi and bhadoi crops in such a way that the district was practically immune from general famine; which crop, occupying about 57 per cent of the area, was the largest?
qh: जिले का कृषि-क्षेत्र अघनी, रबी तथा भदोई फसलों में इस तरह बँटा था कि जिला सामान्य अकाल से लगभग सुरक्षित रहता था; कौन-सी फसल, जो लगभग 57 प्रतिशत क्षेत्र में होती थी, सबसे बड़ी थी?
e: Patna jile me sinchai ka jaal ghana hone tatha aavagaman ke sadhan achhe hone ke karan yahan aam akal ka khatra bahut kam tha. Jile ke kul jotne yogya kshetra ka bantwara is tarah tha - rabi lagbhag 57 pratishat, aghani lagbhag 31 pratishat tatha bhadoi lagbhag 9 pratishat. Iska matlab tha ki log kisi ek fasal ya kisi ek mausam ki fasalon par nirbhar nahi the; agar sthanik varsha fail ho jaati to kisan dakshin se behti nadion tatha pashchim ki nahar vyavastha se apni fasal ke liye paani ka bhandar praapt kar lete the. Iske alawa anaaj rail, sadak, nahar tatha nadi ke raste bahar se mangaya ja sakta tha tatha gaadiyon ya gathar-bailon se jile ke andar sabhi bhaagon me baanta ja sakta tha. Patna Division ke kisi anya jile me niji vyapar ke liye itni suvidha nahi thi tatha na hi khaadya-aapurti khatam hone se itni suraksha thi. Exam point: Jile ke kshetra ka lagbhag 57 pratishat rabi, 31 pratishat aghani tatha 9 pratishat bhadoi fasalon me tha; isi fasal-vividhta tatha achhe sanchar ke karan jila aam akal se lagbhag surakshit raha.

qe: When the famine of 1866 came, work was offered to the distressed on the repair of roads and the excavation of tanks, but less than how many persons attended the works?
qh: 1866 का अकाल आने पर पीड़ित लोगों को सड़कों की मरम्मत तथा तालाब खुदवाने का काम दिया गया, लेकिन इन कार्यों में कितने से कम लोग आए थे?
e: Patna jile me 1866 ka akal Bihar ke anya bhaagon ki tulna me kam asar dikha. Kamzoor vargon me takleef October 1865 se mehsoos hone lagi thi tatha yah sabse tez dakshin me Gaya jile ke paas tatha Bihar subdivision ke ek hisse me thi, kyunki wahan chawal hi lagbhag ekmatra fasal thi aur uski paidawar aadhi-adhoori rah gayi thi. June 1866 me jahan dabav sabse zyada tha, wahan sadkon ki marammat tatha talab khudwane ke kaam peedit logon ko diye gaye, lekin in karya sthalon par 1,000 se bhi kam log aaye. Iske alawa 7 kendron par muft rahat di gayi, par yah rahat lagbhag poori tarah nirdhan, bhikhari tatha doosre jilon se aane wale logon tak hi seemit rahi. June ke ant se November 1866 ke ant tak sthanik fund ke kharch par prati din ausatan sirf 2,147 logon ko sahara diya gaya. Bhukh tatha uchit bhojan ke abhav se utpann rog se marne walon ki pulis dwara report ki gayi sankhya 907 thi. Exam point: 1866 ke akal ke samay kaam par 1,000 se bhi kam log aaye tatha sthanik fund par prati din ausatan 2,147 logon ko rahat di gayi; marne walon ki report ki gayi sankhya 907 thi.

qe: In July 1873 no less than 13.4 inches of rain fell, followed by 11.78 inches more in August; which subdivision, chiefly a rabi and bhadoi country, suffered most from the floods?
qh: जुलाई 1873 में 13.4 इंच से कम वर्षा नहीं हुई और अगस्त में 11.78 इंच और हुई; मुख्यतः रबी तथा भदोई क्षेत्र वाला कौन-सा अनुमंडल बाढ़ से सबसे अधिक प्रभावित हुआ?
e: 1873 me pehle bhari varsha hui tatha uske baad varsha ka lamba sookha chala, jisse fasal par dugna asar pada. Jule 1873 me 13.4 inch varsha hui tatha August me 11.78 inch aur; headquarters subdivision me Bankipore ke dakshin tatha dakshin-pashchim ka kshetra lagbhag poori tarah jalmegh ho gaya, par yah haalat poori tarah asadharan nahi thi. September 1873 me zameendaron ne baadh se hone wale nuksan ki tulna me varsha na hone ki shikayat zyada ki. Barh subdivision, jo mukhyatah rabi tatha bhadoi fasalon ka kshetra tha, baadh se sabse zyada prabhavit hua, jabki Bihar subdivision par asar nahi pada. September tatha October me varsha achhi hone par dhan ki fasal theek hone ki aasha thi, lekin Bankipore me September ke pehle pandrah dinon me sirf 0.98 inch varsha hui tatha Dinapore subdivision me to bilkul varsha nahi hui; October tatha November me kahin bhi ek boond varsha nahi hui. Nateeja yah hua ki Bihar subdivision me dhan ki fasal ausatan ek-tihai tatha baaki jile me saamany varshon ki tulna me sirf aathwan se solahwan hisse tak hi rah gayi, jisse 1874 me zyada abhav hua par akal nahi. Exam point: Jule 1873 ki bhari varsha tatha baad ke sookhe se Barh subdivision, jo rabi tatha bhadoi kshetra tha, sabse zyada prabhavit hua; Bihar subdivision me dhan ki fasal ausatan ek-tihai tatha baaki jile me aathwan se solahwan hisse tak hi rah gayi.

qe: In 1897, when other districts of the division suffered from one of the greatest famines on record, how did the Patna district fare?
qh: 1897 में, जब प्रमंडल के अन्य जिले इतिहास के सबसे बड़े अकालों में से एक से पीड़ित थे, पटना जिले की स्थिति कैसी रही?
oe: It lost a third of its rice crop
It escaped with only slight effects
oh: इसकी धान की फसल का एक-तिहाई नष्ट हो गया
यह मामूली प्रभाव के साथ बच गया
यह पूर्ण अकाल का सामना करने लगा
इसे सरकारी राहत की बड़ी मात्रा मिली
e: 1896 ki varsha na samay par hui aur na paryapt, phir bhi Patna jile ka koi bhi hissa gambhir sankat me nahi aaya. October 1896 ke ant tak varsha ki kami 10.53 inch yaani ausatan ka 25 pratishat thi, lekin yahan varsha ki kami anya kshetron jitni gambhir nahi thi tatha Son canal ka saara uplabdh paani kaam me laaya gaya. Iska nateeja yah hua ki bhadoi fasal 10 aane ki tatha aghani chawal 10.5 aane ki rah gayi, jabki jade ke mausam me samay-samay par varsha hone ke karan rabi fasal 12 aane ki nikli. Islampur thane ke liye shuru me chinta thi, lekin woh jaldi door ho gayi. Ekmatra takleef bhaav ka uncha rehna tha, jisse October 1896 se shahari aabadi tatha sthir aay par jee rahe logon ko kaafi pareshani hui. Is liye vyavaharik roop se koi rahat deni hi nahi padi; sirf United Provinces tatha Bengal ke beech jaane wale bhukhe-pathik logon ko aur bhatakne wale yatriyon ko rasoi-gharon tatha anath-grahon me sahayata di gayi. Exam point: 1897 ke mahan akal me bhi Patna jila bach gaya; varsha me 25 pratishat kami ke bawajood bhadoi 10 aane, aghani dhan 10.5 aane tatha rabi 12 aane ki fasal hui tatha vyavaharik roop se koi rahat deni nahi padi.

qe: The Barh subdivision of Patna district contains a depressed tract of swampy low-lying land known as the Mokameh Tal, situated between the East Indian Railway and the Sakri river; for about how long does it remain under water in the year?
qh: पटना जिले के बाढ़ अनुमंडल में पूर्वी भारत रेलवे तथा सकरी नदी के बीच स्थित मोकामा ताल नामक नीचा दलदली क्षेत्र है; यह वर्ष में लगभग कितने समय जलमग्न रहता है?
e: Patna jile ka Barh subdivision jile ka uttar-purbi hissa hai. Iska kshetra samtal jami ki tarah ek hi level par hai, sirf ek jagah apvaad hai - Mokameh Tal. Yah East Indian Railway tatha Sakri nadi ke beech ka neecha tatha dal-dal wala kshetra hai, jo saal me lagbhag chaar mahine tak paani se bhara rehta hai. Aise neeche kshetra me kheti ka samay kam milta hai tatha paani ki nikaasi ki samasya rehti hai. Barh subdivision me 576 gaon tatha do shahar - Barh tatha Mokameh - hain tatha yah ek lamba tatha thoda patla maarg jaise kshetra hai, jise kai dharaayein uttar-purb ki or kaatti hain; inme sabse mahatvapurna Sakri hai, jo is subdivision ke dakshin-pashchim kone me aati hai tatha dakshin-purb kone se nikal jaati hai. Exam point: Mokameh Tal East Indian Railway tatha Sakri nadi ke beech ka neecha dal-dal wala kshetra hai, jo saal me lagbhag chaar mahine paani me doobaa rehta hai; Barh subdivision me 576 gaon tatha Barh tatha Mokameh do shahar hain.

qe: The Bankipore (sadr) subdivision of Patna district is entirely a flat alluvial plain, intersected by which three rivers?
qh: पटना जिले का बांकीपुर (सदर) अनुमंडल पूरी तरह समतल जलोढ़ मैदान है, जिसे कौन-सी तीन नदियाँ काटती हैं?
e: Patna jile ka Bankipore sadr subdivision Puri tarah samtal alluvial yaani nadi dwara laayi gayi mitti ke maidan par bana hai; isme pahad ya unchaav nahi milta. Is kshetra ko mukhya roop se teen nadiyan kaatti hain - Punpun, Morhar tatha Dardha. In nadiyon ki vajah se yahan ki jami upjau tatha paani ki nikaasi tatha sinchai ka bandobast inhi par nirbhar karta hai. Sadr subdivision me Phulwari tatha Masaurhi thane shamil hain tatha iske thana-kshetra me Phulwari, Masaurhi, Digha, Bakarganj, Patna, Punpun tatha Pabhera jaise police stations hain. Dhyan rahe ki Bihar subdivision ke uttari hisse me alag nadiyan - Son, Phalgu, Panchana tatha Sakri - milyi hain; isliye dono subdivisions ki nadi-vyavastha alag-alag hai. Exam point: Bankipore sadr subdivision ek samtal jalodh maidan hai, jise Punpun, Morhar tatha Dardha nadiyan kaatti hain; is subdivision me Phulwari tatha Masaurhi thane shamil hain.

qe: The Rajgir Hills, which separate much of the Bihar subdivision from the Gaya district, consist of two parallel ridges with a narrow valley between them and seldom exceed what height?
qh: राजगीर की पहाड़ियाँ, जो बिहार अनुमंडल के बड़े भाग को गया जिले से अलग करती हैं, दो समानांतर श्रेणियों से बनी हैं जिनके बीच एक संकरी घाटी है तथा ये प्रायः किस ऊँचाई से अधिक नहीं होतीं?
e: Bihar subdivision jile ke dakshin me hai tatha do alag-alag hisson me bata hua hai. Iska uttari hissa ek samtal jalodh maidan hai, jise Son, Phalgu, Panchana tatha Sakri nadiyan kaatti hain. Iska dakshini hissa Gaya jile se Rajgir ki pahadiyon se alag hota hai. Yah pahadiyan uttar-purb se dakshin-pashchim ki or faili hui do samanantar shreniyon yaani parallel ridges se bani hain tatha inke beech ek sankri ghati hai. Inme bahut se khaddar tatha darre hain, chattanein tatha ghani neechee jungle hai. Yah pahadiyan aam taur par ek hazaar foot se zyada unchi nahi hoti, lekin itihas me inka bahut mahatva hai kyunki inme Bauddh dharm ke kuch sabse purane smarak milte hain. Inhi pahadiyon ke kshetra me Rajgir ka purana shahar tatha uske sthal hain, isliye yah kshetra dharmik tatha puraatatvik dono drishti se mahatvapurna hai. Exam point: Rajgir ki pahadiyan do samanantar shreniyon se bani hain jinke beech ek sankri ghati hai tatha yah aam taur par ek hazaar foot se zyada unchi nahi hoti; inme Bauddh dharm ke purane smarak milte hain.
